axes.h1_ranking: Selected versus leftover realized Light→AX31 (Fast/Balanced) and AX31→K1 (Premium). Weak item ranking is not a bankruptcy failure.
axes.h2_family: Per-family official-weighted quality versus always-light; TV-ball uses the Train–Dev family-mix radius.
axes.h3_k1_tail: Selected Premium K1 realized ΔK versus eligible-unbought AX31, plus selected cost quartiles.
axes.h4_split_shift: Train versus Dev official scores and residual-family mix. Observational only; heads are Train-fitted.
axes.leftover: Positive predicted Fast/Balanced uplift left on Light, and Premium brake binding (eligible unbought).
axes.pin: Dev official score must match the shipped replay pin.
axes.replica_fidelity: Serving replica (select_fast_balanced + promote_premium_brake) must match budget_brake_router.make_submission.
axes.safety: Train/Dev official ratios under 95% of the official cap; composition views must not ruin even after 1.054 inflation.

context_frozen.note: No head is refit. Caps, family-guard multipliers, runaway and brake constants stay shipped.

decision_reasons.conditionally_robust: Safety, pin and replica fidelity passed, but ranking leftover or a family view is the source of robustness. Keep the current runtime.
decision_reasons.fragile: A binding axis failed (pin, replica fidelity, official/view ruin, or TV-ball versus always-light). Current runtime is not certified robust by this audit.
decision_reasons.robust: Binding safety axes passed and H1–H3 are not conditional. Current runtime is a robust champion on the sealed axes.

epsilon_formula: 0.5 * sum_f abs(p_train_f - p_dev_f) from materialized inputs family counts only

motivation.note: Public-team red team applied H1–H4 to competitors, not to Scrooge. Quality-head search is exhausted. This audit asks whether the shipped runtime is a robust champion.

stress_views.definition: full, digest-even/odd, digest-head/tail-200, and each prompt_family with n>=20. Allocator is replayed on the view.
